findings.evidence: PowerCorrections.lean:99 `abbrev smallRatio : Filter ℝ := 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)`; :106 `def ApproximatesToOrder (W Wapp : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : Prop := (fun lam => W lam - Wapp lam) =O[smallRatio] fun lam => lam ^ n`; Matching.lean:159 same body with `F a`, `effectiveAmplitude`, exponent `n+1`.
findings.fix: Hoist `smallRatio`, `ApproximatesToOrder`, `isBigO_pow_of_le` and `ApproximatesToOrder.mono` out of the TMD namespace into the asymptotics layer this PR already creates (e.g. `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/Analysis/Asymptotics/`), update the TMD uses to the moved names (no alias, per the no-compatibility rule), and define `IsMatching n F M c := ∀ a, ApproximatesToOrder (F a) (P.effectiveAmplitude n (M a) c) (n + 1)`. NRQCD must not import the TMD module, so the shared definition has to move rather than be imported from there; the mono lemma then comes for free.
findings.issue: `IsMatching n F M c` is `∀ a, (fun ε => F a ε - effectiveAmplitude …) =O[𝓝[>] 0] fun ε => ε ^ (n+1)`, which is definitionally `∀ a, ApproximatesToOrder (F a) (P.effectiveAmplitude n (M a) c) (n + 1)` — the predicate already in the repo at EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton/TMD/PowerCorrections.lean:106-107 with `smallRatio := 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)` (line 99). Two parallel names for the same `λ → 0⁺` approximation relation, so the existing lemmas about it (`ApproximatesToOrder.mono`, `isBigO_pow_of_le`, PowerCorrections.lean:110-119) do not apply to `IsMatching`.

findings.evidence: grep for `eq_zero_of_isLittleO_sum_range_pow_smul_pow` in ./code gives only TruncatedExpansion.lean:61 (declaration) and :93 (inside `isLittleO_sum_range_pow_smul_pow_iff`); PowerCorrections.lean:132 calls the `_succ_iff` form, not this one.
findings.fix: Mark it `private` (as the two helper lemmas above it already are) and let callers use `isLittleO_sum_range_pow_smul_pow_iff`; note `isBigO_sum_range_pow_smul_pow_succ_iff` has no such directional twin, so this also makes the two results consistent.
findings.issue: `eq_zero_of_isLittleO_sum_range_pow_smul_pow` is public but is exactly `(isLittleO_sum_range_pow_smul_pow_iff hl).1` (it is used only to prove that iff, at line 93, and nowhere else in the repo); the module docstring lists only the two iffs as main results, so this is an undocumented second public name for the same implication.

summary: The analytic core is new and reuses upstream API well, but `IsMatching` is a second copy of the existing EpsilonEridani predicate `ApproximatesToOrder` (same filter, same relation, defeq), and `eq_zero_of_isLittleO_sum_range_pow_smul_pow` duplicates the forward direction of the iff that is the file's documented API.
